colors.name: paper
colors.role: background — warm off-white stock; the page is a sheet laid on the studio table (ink 15.6:1)

colors.name: ink
colors.role: all functional text, 3px shape outlines, terrazzo speckle — 15.6:1 on paper, 6.4–11.3:1 on the warm surfaces

colors.name: teal
colors.role: accent — hero fill, focus ring, marquee row B, the studio's signature color. Ink on it holds 6.59:1 (AA). As text on paper it is only 2.4:1 — decorative/surface only, never text

colors.name: coral
colors.role: Memphis pink — blobs, project tiles, ::selection, clip-path fills. Ink on it holds 6.4:1 (AA)

colors.name: marigold
colors.role: sunny yellow — squiggle strokes, confetti, CTA surface, highlight halos. Ink on it holds 11.3:1 (AAA)

colors.name: cobalt
colors.role: deep blue — the disciplined counterpoint; section heads as text (5.1:1 AA on paper), and surfaces that carry WHITE type (5.7:1). Ink on cobalt is only 3.07:1 so cobalt surfaces never carry ink body text

colors.name: plum
colors.role: terazzo fleck + secondary accent — ink-text safe at 7.0:1 on paper, used for the rare purple speck and link underlines

fonts.role: Latin display + body + labels — geometric, engineered; the studio's drafting hand across its full weight range
every Hangul glyph — a heavy geometric Korean face cut like paper; the studio's loud Korean voice

texture: One fixed, pointer-transparent SVG rect over the whole viewport filtered through feTurbulence (fractalNoise, baseFrequency 0.9, numOctaves 2, stitchTiles) into a feColorMatrix that zeroes RGB and scales noise alpha to ~0.08, blended with mix-blend-mode: multiply at opacity 0.45 — static paper/tooth grain, never animated. Under it, terrazzo: scattered multicolor flecks (teal/coral/marigold/cobalt/plum chips) drawn as small rotated polygons in a single decorative SVG band, low opacity, multiply-blended so the ground reads as speckled handmade stock rather than flat screen.

motion.name: clip-wipe-in
motion.value: scroll-triggered: shapes wipe in via animated clip-path (inset → full) over 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), staggered 70ms per shape; the polygon cut is the reveal

motion.name: parallax-drift
motion.value: pointer-parallax: --mp-x/--mp-y (−1…1, lerped by 0.06/frame at 60fps) multiplied into depth-scaled translate3d — near shapes drift up to ±26px, far shapes ±8px

motion.name: parallax-idle
motion.value: mutually-prime idle bob (4.6s–9.8s) on each shape so the field is alive without a pointer (touch fallback)

motion.name: flip-play
motion.value: FLIP: First/Last rects measured, Invert applied as transform on play, 480ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) to rest — filter changes reorganize the project grid with no layout jump

motion.name: flip-fade
motion.value: incoming cards fade opacity 0→1 over the same 480ms; outgoing 1→0 in the first 160ms so they leave before the move reads

motion.name: marquee-base
motion.value: 0.05 px/ms (~50px/s) constant drift; two rows opposite directions, JS-toggled for touch/reduced

motion.name: btn-press
motion.value: 0ms in / 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) out — a shape pressing into the page, not a spring

motion.name: squiggle-draw
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset 100% → 0% over 900ms ease-out on scroll-in, staggered — the squiggle draws itself
